Area.evidence_source: A few of the decedents seemed to have already been alcohol abusers or alcoholics as the following quotes suggest: ". . . his life was all about drinking . . ." (case2:informant3) or "my brother had a bad habit of drinking alcohol . . ." (case2:informant2). Because of this, they may have become either emotionally disinhibited or socially irresponsible, the outcome of which exposed them to suicide as elaborated further below.
